text: San Francisco is a town and municipality located in the Antioquia Department of Colombia, within the Eastern Antioquia subregion. As of 2015, its population was 5,318 people. The area was previously known as El Morrón and was founded in 1830 as part of the municipality of Cocorná. It was officially established as a separate municipality in February 1986, named San Francisco in honor of Saint Francis of Assisi. San Francisco has a tropical rainforest climate classified as Af, characterized by heavy rainfall throughout the year. The literacy rate in the area was 75.5% in 2005.
